entries.title: An ant guarding the jaggery
entries.literal_meaning: An ant as the guard of the jaggery store.
entries.explanation: The supposed guard has an appetite for exactly what it must protect. The dictionary uses this mismatch for entrusting something to its would-be consumer: the arrangement itself puts the goods at risk. In conversation, the image can make a questionable appointment look absurd before anyone has to explain it at length. It questions a particular conflict between duty and temptation, rather than declaring that a whole kind of person is dishonest.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯାହାକୁ ଜଗିବାକୁ ଦିଆଗଲା, ଜଗୁଆଳିର ଲୋଭ ସେହି ଜିନିଷ ଉପରେ—ଚିତ୍ରଟିର ମଜା ଏଇଠି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଖାଦ୍ୟକୁ ତାହାର ଖାଦକ ଜିମାରେ ଦେବାର ଅସଙ୍ଗତି ବୁଝାଇଛି। କୌଣସି ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଦେବା ବେଳେ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଓ ନିଜର ଲୋଭ ମୁହାଁମୁହିଁ ହେଉଥିଲେ, ଏହି ଛୋଟ ଚିତ୍ର ବଡ଼ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ବିନା କଥାଟି ଧରାଇଦିଏ। ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ସେହି ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାକୁ ନେଇ, କୌଣସି ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀକୁ ଜନ୍ମରୁ ଅସାଧୁ କହିବାକୁ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: A guard tempted to consume the very thing entrusted to them.
entries.odia_summary: ଯାହାକୁ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବା କଥା, ଜଗୁଆଳିର ଲୋଭ ସେଇଠି।
entries.usage_example: A club puts its snack box in the charge of the member who keeps finishing the biscuits before meetings. Another member laughs, “ଗୁଡ଼ଘରେ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଜଗୁଆଳି!” They agree to keep the box available only when everyone arrives. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: The source explicitly explains entrusting food to its consumer. Modern organizational use is editorial extension, not documented origin. Parenthetical ପରିଛା is an alternative guard term in the source, not a new saying.

entries.title: The ant grows wings
entries.explanation: The image sounds like a new freedom, but the dictionary turns it into a sign of approaching ruin or death. That reversal gives the expression its ominous force: what looks like an advance is read as a warning. A speaker may use it when another person becomes recklessly confident, though that particular application is an editorial example rather than a separate source gloss. The image carries an old belief; it is not a biological account of winged ants or a prediction that someone must come to harm.
entries.meaning_odia: ଡେଣା ଲାଗିବା ଶୁଣିଲେ ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନତାର ଚିତ୍ର ଆସେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ସର୍ବନାଶ ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପୂର୍ବର ସମୟ ଭାବେ ବୁଝାଇଛି। ଯାହା ଉନ୍ନତି ପରି ଦିଶୁଛି, ସେହି କଥାକୁ ବିପଦର ସଙ୍କେତ କରିଦେବାରେ ଉକ୍ତିଟିର ତୀବ୍ରତା। କେହି ବେପରୁଆ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଦେଖାଇଲେ ଏପରି କହିବାର ଏକ କଳ୍ପିତ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ହୋଇପାରେ; ଅଭିଧାନ କିନ୍ତୁ ସେହି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଇନାହିଁ। ଏଠି ପୁରୁଣା ବିଶ୍ୱାସର ଛବି ଅଛି, ଡେଣାଥିବା ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ିର ଜୀବନ ବିଷୟରେ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ ଦାବି ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: An apparent gain becomes an ominous image of approaching ruin in the source’s gloss.
entries.odia_summary: ଲାଭ ପରି ଦିଶୁଥିବା ଡେଣାକୁ ସ୍ରୋତର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଆସନ୍ନ ବିପଦର ଛବି କରାଯାଇଛି।
entries.usage_example: After one successful event, an organizer announces a much larger one without checking the costs. A friend remarks, “ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ିର ପକ୍ଷୀ ଲାଗିବା!” The organizer asks for the actual budget concerns rather than taking the remark as a prediction. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Explicit source gloss is approaching ruin/death. Preserve its severe warning register; do not soften it into a simple celebration of growth or teach the surrounding obsolete zoology as fact. Digital ପକ୍ଷୀ retained exactly; printed note2 visually checked without silent modern replacement by ଡେଣା.

entries.odia: ହାତୀ ଗଳି ଯାଉଛି ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଗଳିବାକୁ ବାଟ ନାହିଁ
entries.title: An elephant passes, an ant is stopped
entries.literal_meaning: An elephant passes through, but there is no way for an ant.
entries.explanation: The impossible difference in scale makes the complaint funny: a passage admits an elephant but somehow cannot admit an ant. The dictionary explains this as overlooking large matters while keeping watch over small ones. The target is misplaced scrutiny, not careful attention itself. In an argument, the image can turn the question back on the person enforcing a tiny rule: what larger thing have they allowed to pass?
entries.meaning_odia: ହାତୀ ଗଳିଯାଉଛି, ଅଥଚ ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ ବାଟ ନାହିଁ—ଆକାରର ଏହି ଅସମ୍ଭବ ଫରକରେ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ। ଅଭିଧାନ ବଡ଼ ବଡ଼ କଥାରେ ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ନରଖି ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ବିଷୟକୁ ଜଗିବା କଥା କହିଛି। ଖୁଟିନାଟି ଦେଖିବା ନିଜେ ଭୁଲ ନୁହେଁ; ବଡ଼ ତ୍ରୁଟି ଛାଡ଼ି କେବଳ ଛୋଟ କଥାରେ ଅଟକିବାକୁ ଏହା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ। କେହି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ନିୟମ ଧରି ବସିଲେ, ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର ତାଙ୍କୁ ବଡ଼ ଅବହେଳାଟି ଦେଖାଇପାରେ।
entries.english_summary: Large lapses pass unnoticed while tiny matters face strict scrutiny.
entries.odia_summary: ବଡ଼ ଅବହେଳା ଛାଡ଼ି ଛୋଟ କଥାକୁ କଠୋର ଭାବେ ଜଗିବା।
entries.usage_example: A committee approves a large unexplained expense, then spends half an hour disputing a tiny stationery claim. A member says, “ହାତୀ ଗଳି ଯାଉଛି ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଗଳିବାକୁ ବାଟ ନାହିଁ,” and asks to examine the larger bill first. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Printed4856 note3 resolves digital ବାୟ as ବାଟ. The source explains unequal attention to large/small matters, not a particular legal system or caste. Both alternative forms belong to one analogy.

entries.title: An ant climbing the lampstand
entries.literal_meaning: Being an ant and climbing onto the lampstand.
entries.explanation: The dictionary applies this small creature and high perch to a “small” person intervening in “big” matters. The wording does more than describe scale: it can dismiss someone’s right to take part by placing them below the subject under discussion. That ranking belongs to the source’s social judgment, not a fact about anyone’s worth or ability. Read critically, the analogy lets us hear how a vivid image can keep a person out of a conversation instead of answering what they said.
entries.meaning_odia: ଛୋଟ ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଦୀପରୁଖାର ଛବିକୁ ଅଭିଧାନ ‘ଛୋଟ ଲୋକ’ ହୋଇ ‘ବଡ଼ କଥା’ରେ ହସ୍ତକ୍ଷେପ କରିବା ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିଛି। ଏହା କେବଳ ଆକାରର ତୁଳନା ନୁହେଁ; କାହାକୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ କରି ତାଙ୍କ କଥା କହିବାର ଅଧିକାରକୁ ଅସ୍ୱୀକାର କରିବାର ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟ ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି। ସେହି ଉଚ୍ଚନୀଚ ବିଚାର ସ୍ରୋତର ପ୍ରୟୋଗର ଅଂଶ, କାହାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ବା ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରି ପଢ଼ିଲେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ, ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବା ବଦଳରେ ଏକ ଚିତ୍ର କିପରି ଲୋକଟିକୁ ଆଲୋଚନାରୁ ବାହାରେ ରଖିପାରେ।
entries.english_summary: A historical analogy can dismiss a supposedly insignificant person’s participation in larger matters.
entries.odia_summary: କାହାକୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ ଭାବି ବଡ଼ କଥାରେ ତାଙ୍କ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକୁ ଖାରଜ କରିବାର ଏକ ପୁରୁଣା ଉପମା।
entries.usage_example: At a residents’ meeting, a newcomer questions an expense. Someone dismisses the question with “ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ହୋଇ ଦୀପରୁଖାରେ ଚଢ଼ିବା.” Another resident replies that the question should be answered, whoever asked it. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: An unnumbered analogy follows note3 and precedes5 in both witnesses; labelled fourth position for this audit only. Source’s ଛୋଟ ଲୋକ is not evidence of a named caste, innate inferiority or lack of ability. Critical reading preserves the dismissive register, not an endorsed lesson to stay in one’s place.
